ValidationRule.description: Coach cannot select below status values for Customer Nudge Tasks: Customer Archived Auto Archived Read By Customer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.Name == 'Customer Nudge', NOT($Profile.Name = 'Minimum Access - External Apps'), NOT($Profile.Name = 'Minimum Access - Salesforce'), NOT($Profile.Name = 'Minimum Access - Salesforce'), ISCHANGED( Status ), NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status, 'Escalated')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ACTIVITY_STATE_AUTO_ARCHIVED'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ACTIVITY_STATE_CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ACTIVITY_STATE_SENT'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ACTIVITY_STATE_READ')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The status values (Customer Archived, Auto Archived, Read By Customer, Sent) cannot be changed manually.
